name: Hoarfrost
body:
School evocation [water, cold]; Level sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a cold iron ring)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target you
Duration 1 min. or until discharged Save yes (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

A thin nimbus of ice surrounds any melee weapon you hold during the spell’s duration. The next creature you successfully attack with an affected weapon takes 1d3 hp cold damage in addition to any weapon damage and the spell ends. This damage is subject to spell resistance.
